name: com.brainworks.bw_audio
description:
Unity control client for the bw_audio spatial-audio engine: a thin P/Invoke binding over the engine's C ABI (no audio crosses the boundary, only control). Drives a 26-speaker CAVE array over ASIO/Dante with a binaural debug monitor. Provides a centralized per-frame push (BwAudio.Engine) and a positional emitter (BwAudio.Emitter).

Windows x64 only (ASIO is Windows-only). Ships the native engine (bw_audio.dll + phonon.dll) — see the README for the required project setup (disable Unity's built-in audio).
